muxwebserv.Root-backed file transfer for your stora:
File transfer for your storage folders (SD1 and, when inserted, SD2). Enabling it grants read and write access to those folders; the system stays out of reach. Connect on port 2022 with the username muos and password muos.

Select this to open its settings.

muxdetail.Everything MustardOS knows about this de:
Everything MustardOS knows about this device, grouped into sections. Left and Right move between them.

This is an unofficial port of MustardOS for the R36S/R35S. The MustardOS team does not support this device: ask for help at github.com/laurorual/MustardOS-R36S-port.
muxdetail.The MustardOS release this device is run: The MustardOS release this unofficial R36S/R35S port is based on. The MustardOS team does not support this port: ask for help at github.com/laurorual/MustardOS-R36S-port, not on MustardOS channels. Select it to check whether any system files have been altered.
muxdetail.The build this release was made from. Us: The build of this unofficial R36S/R35S port. Include it when you report a problem at github.com/laurorual/MustardOS-R36S-port (not to the MustardOS team).
